outcome_rule.description: For any game between players with starting ranks i and j (where i < j, so player i has the higher rating), compute k = (3*i + 7*j) mod 10. If k is in {0,1,2,3,4,5}, player i wins. If k is in {6,7}, the game is drawn. If k is in {8,9}, player j wins (upset). The outcome depends only on the player IDs, not on colors or round number.

notes: Player IDs correspond to starting rank (TPN) and are ordered by descending rating.
With an even number of players, no pairing-allocated bye (PAB) should occur in any round.
ARO computation: sum ratings of over-the-board opponents / count, rounded to nearest integer (0.5 rounds up).
Over-the-board games have result codes: '1' (win), '0' (loss), '=' (draw). Forfeits ('+'/'-') are NOT over-the-board.
